role: Dynamically decide which reasoning layers are worth running
pipeline_position: Master Orchestrator -> Reasoning Weight Engine -> Select Layers -> Execute Only Selected Layers -> Muse-Glimmer
weight_calculation: weight = accuracy_gain + reuse_rate + success_rate - latency_cost, normalized 0.00 to 1.00

important.label: IMPORTANT
important.action: Run for medium or hard problems

keep_rule: KEEP if same or better accuracy AND lower latency AND fewer unnecessary layers execute, otherwise DELETE
notes: A layer survives because it improves outcomes. A layer runs because it is useful right now. Translation OS should use minimum amount of reasoning necessary to solve problem correctly.
